title: 药到 · 给爸妈的 AI 用药管家 — 最小端到端测试分镜
note: AI-director-shaped storyboard used as the scheduler input. Assets in this E2E are FFmpeg-synthesised LOCAL test material, NOT AI-generated and NOT real footage; no hosted generation quota is consumed.

shots.purpose: 开场：产品名与一句话价值
shots.prompt: warm kitchen, elderly person, soft morning light, title card
shots.narration: 一句「我吃过药了」，就够了。
shots.subtitle: 一句「我吃过药了」，就够了

shots.purpose: 章节一：一句话建档，按早中晚提醒
shots.prompt: three meal-time cards, morning noon evening, clear iconography
shots.narration: 说一句服药规律，它复述确认，第二天还记得。
shots.subtitle: 早 / 午 / 晚，按时提醒

shots.purpose: 片尾：安全边界与品牌落版
shots.prompt: calm end card with brand name and safety note
shots.narration: 药到只做提醒和记录，用药问题请问您的大夫。
shots.subtitle: 只做提醒 · 不替您拿主意
